verdict.rationale: Docusaurus documents the core of this story first-party. You can import global custom CSS through the classic theme, swap any theme component for your own through swizzling, customize layout with React components, and import your own components into MDX. Community users praise its configurability and flexibility. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of font customization, documented injection of custom JS (e.g., client modules or scripts), theme color/branding configuration details, and independent hands-on corroboration of brand-matching customization.

support.subject: As a DevRel lead, I customize themes, fonts, and layout — down to custom CSS/JS or my own components — so the docs match my brand

citations.quote: you can create your own CSS files (e.g. `/src/css/custom.css`) and import them globally by passing them as an option of the classic theme.
swizzling permits to **swap a theme component with your own implementation**
Extend and customize your project's layout by writing React components. Leverage the pluggable architecture, and design your own site while reusing the same data created by Docusaurus plugins.
You can also import your own components defined in other files or third-party components installed via npm.
Nice theme out of the box / configuration.
